# nostr-post

> Manifest-driven UI engine for complex structured Nostr content (Reviews, Articles, Events, Venues) with automatic event coordination, field-level visibility controls, plugin composition, and NIP-78 manifest storage.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/saintego/nostr-post): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://saintego.github.io/nostr-post/): Official website and documentation.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
